programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Pacific
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Journey to the Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Ever wondered how to look after dozens of tiny turtles? This episode of An Aquatic Life will show you just that! Meet the turtle team and their amazing ambassadors, Bob, Sandy and the monstrous loggerhead, Yoshi! The collections team is running at half capacity while most of the team members collect Ragged-Toothed Sharks in East London for the upcoming predator exhibit... But with a colossal storm en route to the city of Cape Town, will it all be ready for their arrival?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: For years, at least four highly elusive wolfpacks have lived and hunted on the edge of the wild city of Anchorage. But as the city spreads further and further into wolf country, the wolves are now getting bolder, and attacks on humans are on the increase. A group was recently targeted whilst jogging with their dog on a trail near one of the city's main roads.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

Together they go in search of the elephant Apollo, which was resettled in the sanctuary. The former "problem" elephant now leads a peaceful life here.

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale

An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers

The tigers could kill humans and eat them. The people living around the forests are also one of the poorest in the country. They have to go inside the forest to eke out a living by catching crabs and fish. And that's the opportunity the tiger may seek.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels

They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Deserts

But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

The Real Merlin finds a sixth-century druid, shaman and right-hand man to the last pagan king, a prophet who predicted his own strange three-fold death.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: What's going on inside Area 51, America's most carefully guarded secret? The mysterious military base located 30 minutes north west of Las Vegas has been rumored to be UFO crash sites.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Can radiation from electrical appliances, power lines, microwave ovens, and wireless technology such as cell phones and baby monitors alter our DNA, cause illness and lead to disease? Richard speaks with a leading researcher on the biological effects of Electro-Magnetic Fields, a retired police officer campaigning to have wireless Internet banned from schools and public places.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time man has expressed his religious beliefs through rock art, it gives the feeling that he has worshipped some mysterious gods, that generally came from the stars. Over the millennia, these gods have changed in shape and name, but the way they have been disguised in our beliefs remains the same, in many cases to the misfortune of the witnesses.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From Mafasca, in the plains of Fuerteventura, to Pardal, in the mountains of Albacete, passing through the light of Cayón in Cantabria, we are talking about intelligent luminosities. These are seen at night and have even followed witnesses. They are the most commonly seen lights, undoubtedly a phenomenon that is part of another of the strangest aspects of the UFO theme: The foo- fighters.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: U.S. Presidents are the most powerful men on the planet. But do they know something about extraterrestrials that we don't? We'll explore the complex relationship between Aliens and Presidents.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The Great Pyramids. The Sphinx. Egypt was a civilization millennia ahead of its time. Were their technological advances the product of human genius or could the Egyptians have had help?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many people believe we are not alone. But if aliens share this planet, what are their plans for us? We'll unseal the Top 10 Alien Plots and let you know if ET came in peace or if he has something else in mind.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: As the Curiosity Rover searches Mars for signs of life, the question becomes: Could Mars have been first? We'll explore the shocking possibility that sentient life began on Mars and traveled here.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: It seems the world is fascinated with all things science fiction. First it was vampires, then werewolves, and now Zombies. But could this once seemingly far fetched idea be closer to happening then we ever thought possible? Are zombies becoming a reality?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: New developments in science and research have invented equipment that may have much more sinister capabilities than we are being led to believe. Are governments around the world using weather control to incite the next World War and possibly destroy the planet?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The past few decades have been filled with stunning technological advancement. But is all this 'progress' good for humanity? Animal cloning has been a reality for decades but the disturbing experiments going on behind close doors will shock you. Human cloning may be much closer than you think.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The warden's calling for diagnostics for Detroit Muscle's next prisoner, their 1969 Pontiac GTO. They'll have to tear down and look inside the skeleton of this old muscle car before they fix it up.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Engine Power kicks off a brand new, ground up engine, built on Chevy's original big block: The W-Series. An aluminum aftermarket engine block lays the foundation and is filled with a stroker rotating assembly to create a big inch pump gas monster.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass guys pick up the power plant for their grassroots racer and start assembling the heart of the beast with power producing components.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Today we'll show you the 5 most common reasons your engine won't start...and how to fix it!
programme.sub-title: Top 5 Reasons Why Your Engine Won't Start

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The team ventures to the north Georgia mountains to pick up and test an '07 Jeep Wrangler JK, then we head to the Summit Racing store in search of parts to mod it for extreme off-road fun!
programme.sub-title: Modding A Jeep Wrangler JK Into An Extreme Off-Road Weekend Warrior Part 1

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The guys show you how to create a custom steering column for your race car that won't break the bank. Plus, they will fabricate a custom dash to accept their new digital gauge cluster, and show you an easy way to wire your project.
programme.sub-title: Road Course Camaro Part 10 Custom Dash Panel

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc almost double the horsepower on a 2008 Ford 4.6L Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor. The solution for more power is adding a small tailpipe turbo, exhaust and fuel mods. Then the dyno don't lie! From 200HP to 368HP, this Vic is ready for high pursuit!
programme.sub-title: Boosting A Crown Vic Police Interceptor 160 Horsepower

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We're back in the shop with our '69 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, and this week it's all about knocking out what we can to keep this build moving. From getting the rear suspension bolted in, to plumbing the fuel system, wiring up the dash with some old-school toggle switches, and even spraying paint on some custom parts - it's one of those "do what you can, when you can" kind of days. It's the grunt work of the project, but it's real progress, and that's what counts.
programme.sub-title: Project Bullseye - Suspension, Fuel System, & Custom Dash

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel give the '69 Road Runner's interior a much-needed makeover. We'll restore the dash and give the seats and headliner some much needed attention.
programme.sub-title: Tackling The Worn Out Road Runner Interior - Part 4

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel kick off a new project, a 1971 Chevy Caprice. They search through a big-body boneyard to find the inspiration to help separate this car from stereotypical b-body builds.
programme.sub-title: Tearing Down A 1971 Chevy Caprice - Fat Stack Part 1

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We plumb the turbocharger in our 1964 Ford Flatbed truck. We'll also install the fuel and cooling systems. After a tune-up we'll head to the Engine Power shop and test our work on their chassis dyno.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton make a plan of attack to resurrect a 1966 Chevy Nova, a first for the Detroit Muscle shop. After their upscale treatment, this Nova, codenamed Project Starstruck, will be a low, mean, aggressive street machine with killer looks.
programme.sub-title: Basket Case - Rusted, Busted, and Ruined

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We take our hefty hearse down the eighth mile with a little help from some throttle in the bottle ... Plus, some old school tech that may hit home.
programme.sub-title: Caddy Hearse Hits The Drag Strip To Prove Its Power

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Clutch Performance - The guys finalize Fat Stack's transformation from automatic to manual as they install the clutch and pedal assembly in their '71 Caprice.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The MCT crew builds the Ford nine inch for our OBS Chevy. We'll show you an inexpensive way to change the color of your interior panels. Then we'll start prepping our body for its new color scheme.
programme.sub-title: OBS 632 SS Part 5 Color Cover Up

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: It's clearance time in XOR! The Jeep JL is getting ready for their upcoming Off Road Adventure with new custom-built fenders and a MagnaFlow exhaust.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Searching for more power, let's add Nitrous and see what happens when our Chevy small block gets on the bottle!
programme.sub-title: How Much Nitrous for 720HP in a Small Block?

programme.title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live "Crushing It"
programme.desc: With Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live returning to the big screen, see our Designer Round Table and learn about the design process in making a toy monster truck. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live gives you an under the hood look at the iconic cars that call the Hot Wheels garage home.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: The Ram 1 ton dually gets a bigger badder turbo setup with more airflow for more horsepower. Plus, Advanced Plating in Nashville shows us how to powder coat suspension parts.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Learn how to do a rustic looking patina paint job on your ride, and see a quick way to ratchet up the performance numbers on a late model pony.
programme.sub-title: Sydewinder Patina Paint and Late Model Tuning

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.
programme.sub-title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Mike and Pat stroke a vintage junkyard Ford 390 but an unexpected surprise puts a delay in their progress. Then it's full steam ahead for finding the limit for this big block stump puller
programme.sub-title: Stump Pulling Stroked Big Block 390 FE

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Adding more Stop and Go to our C5 Corvette Z06 for the track. Taking our Z06 to the Corvette proving grounds, now it can handle the track to strut its stuff!
programme.sub-title: Before and After: Z06 Track Test with Bolt-On Upgrades

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We're back on our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We send our truck out to an expert who will create and install a custom audio system and interior. That will help us BUMP UP our street cred in the Mini Truck scene.
programme.sub-title: Low-Fi S-10: New Audio System & Interior

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.
programme.sub-title: How to Install a Convertible Top

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The final touches are added to our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Truck project. Then we hit the open road and see our LOW-Fi lay frame for the first time. This is a MUST SEE show!
programme.sub-title: Low-Fi S-10: We Wrap Up and Lay Frame!

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Eric and Joel unearth the Cummins-crown-jewel dually diesel, a '93 Dodge Ram W350, and break down how they will shift this one-ton highway hauler into the ultimate blue-collar bruiser.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: The TIMELESS Debate is on. Ford vs. Chevy. We start with a stock 305 Chevy and a 302 Ford. After an initial baseline, we see how they stack up against each other with the same mild upgrades. We find out, dollar for horsepower, who comes out on top.
programme.sub-title: Ford vs Chevy: Small Displacement Showdown

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass crew starts a new project, taking a rough around the edges 1972 Camaro Split Bumper and turning into a powerhouse race car. We tear this car down to make room for a set of mini wheel tubs and a new fuel cell.
programme.sub-title: Starting the Transformation of a 1972 Camaro Split Bumper Into A Full Tilt Race Car

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Our Silverado 632 SS project is getting close to completion. We relocate our battery and start wiring so we can power our systems. We refurbish some interior pieces to match our new color scheme, then add some extra grip with a traction control module.
programme.sub-title: OBS 632 SS Part 7 Refresh and Reuse

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: The supercharged big block Blazer hits the trails in search of a big mud hole.
programme.sub-title: Supercharged '89 K5 Square Body Searches For a Mud Hole

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc have new project in the shop and have some unique plans that pay homage to the street machine era. But to do that they need to see what they have to work with.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our 460 Big Block Ford is back for its final iteration, where we upgrade it with a weight saving, better flowing induction. We're looking to up the naturally aspirated horsepower before this beast finds its new home. As always, we'll test our improvement on the Engine Dyno.
programme.sub-title: Better Breathing for our Big Block Ford

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Assembly on the 4.3L engine begins with a solid bottom end, including a set of forged pistons and a bigger cam shaft.
programme.sub-title: In-Depth Build Of An Old School Chevy 4.3L V6 Build Part 1

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: To make our '72 Chevy Camaro lighter we'll need to shed some weight. We'll show the step-by-step process on how to make your own custom carbon fiber body panels.
programme.sub-title: Camaro Racecar Sheds Weight With Carbon Fiber

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Caprice Wagon is back in the shop for the rest of its upgrades. Jimmy and Jeremy add a new drivetrain to give our cruiser a boost in horsepower and then we add a few custom touches before taking the whole tribe on a cross town adventure in the Carcass family truckster.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We restore a '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket's finish to a showroom shine and update the exterior with decals that put the icing on the cake.
programme.sub-title: Retro Hurst Olds Exterior Gets Restored Back To Its Showroom Finish - Part 2

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make 1000 Horsepower starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.
programme.sub-title: How to Build a 1000HP Diesel Beast

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.
programme.sub-title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew rescues a familiar green 1971 Chevy Caprice, dropping a few tips and tricks along the way while diagnosing issues that can easily go unseen.
programme.sub-title: Rescuing A 1971 Chevy Caprice From Driveway Death

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are helping a Marine Corp veteran get his Jeep Comanche back up and running - right in his own driveway!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Sydewinder gets its engine bay buttoned up and a whole new interior.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We add a body kit and a wrap to our EBC Brakes giveaway Mustang plus, Tommy and Marc bring back the Hellcat '69 Charger.
programme.sub-title: Modding a Mustang GT for an Aggressive Look

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass duo add power, and huge tires to the Willys mud wagon for the ultimate mud adventure.
programme.sub-title: Chevy M1010 Gets Extra Power and Huge Tires for the Ultimate Mud Adventure

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Project Night shift is back in the shop! The guys install a rebuilt transfer case in our '93 Dodge Diesel Dually. They also plumb in our bigger turbo setup, showing you how to bead roll your tubing to make a secure fit. Plus, they'll show you the tools you'll need make your own brake lines.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: It's no secret that LS engine swaps are the go-to for adding power to your ride. Tommy and Joel walk you through what to do when looking for an LS and even show you how to start it before it goes in your car.
programme.sub-title: What To Look For In An LS Engine

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Clutch performance - Today Tommy and Joel install a new third pedal and show you the do's and don'ts on how to bleed the transmission to make your ride run smooth. Then, the dash gets an upgrade but its aesthetic stays true to its retro-glory.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We kick off a ground up build based around Summit's brand new, specially designed Small Block Chevy engine block. Featuring a large bore and stroke equaling 427ci, this robust platform will become the foundation for a high horsepower, pump gas, street dominator.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Start your engines - The day has finally come as the guys finish up their 1969 GTO, Project Henchman, and take it on its first drive. They add a few finishing touches and show you how to carefully install a spoiler on finished paint, along with some slick new stripes, and even walk you through how to get some 3D-printed hard-to-find pieces that put the cherry on top of this menacing muscle car.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: We take apart our 6.6L Duramax from our '11 Denali HD for an upgrade to 1000HP. Plus, we meet a diesel junkie who built a Cummins powered Ford Ranger pocket rocket for the dragstrip.
programme.sub-title: Tearing Down a Duramax to Prep for 1000 HP

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass duo fab up some custom body mounts for a first look at the Chevy M1010 and Willys Wagon combo. Plus, a sneak peak at the powerhouse that will drive it all.
programme.sub-title: Dropping Our '53 Willy's Wagon Body On Its New Chassis

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, from a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six, Mike and Pat celebrate their vintage builds and how they turned retro into big modern muscle.
programme.sub-title: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, to a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Eric and Joel unearth the Cummins-crown-jewel dually diesel, a '93 Dodge Ram W350, and break down how they will shift this one-ton highway hauler into the ultimate blue-collar bruiser.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Our Lo 'n Slo, C10 project breaks tradition by ditching its rotted wood bed floor for an easy install aluminum kit that mimics the real thing. Plus, the guys in Engine Power explode our 292 straight-six for a full rebuild.
programme.sub-title: Installing an Aluminum Bed Floor Kit in a Chevy C10

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Dragonali's Duramax gets a lift pump to handle higher horsepower. And our '65 C10 Lo 'n Slo is back with the rebuilt 292 straight-six. It's fitted on the Engine Power dyno for some initial pulls.
programme.sub-title: Duramax Diesel Fuel Upgrades for High Performance

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We just can't stop searching for more power from our Small Block Chevy! It's getting high-octane race fuel, more aggressive timing, and a bigger cam.
programme.sub-title: Will Race Fuel And A Bigger Cam Improve Power On The Chevy 350 Dyno Mule?

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: With a fully rebuilt 292 straight-six under the hood, we finish up our patina classic in time to put on some road miles, and check out James Otto's '66 C10 built in an entirely different way.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Start your engines - The day has finally come as the guys finish up their 1969 GTO, Project Henchman, and take it on its first drive. programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Grease and gears begin to fly as we swap out our '83 Hurst-Olds' measly 307 engine for one built in the Horsepower shop with the help of legendary engine builder Joe Mondello. This big block is truly one-of-a-kind.
programme.sub-title: Dropping A Legendary Mondello 455 Big Block Into The Retro Hurst Olds - Part 3

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We're back on our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We send our truck out to an expert who will create and install a custom audio system and interior. That will help us BUMP UP our street cred in the Mini Truck scene.
programme.sub-title: Low-Fi S-10: New Audio System & Interior

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Paint by numbers - Painting a '69 Dodge Dart? We'll show you how to get perfect factory-match paint! Our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, is a bare shell providing the perfect blank canvas. Brian will show you some easy DIY color mixing methods for perfect pigment matching paint to get your project back to factory spec.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Marc and Tommy rip into the automatic transmission tearing it out of our turbo charged Police Interceptor and swapping it for a head jerking manual 5 speed. Then they take to the track in hot pursuit of some quick times.
programme.sub-title: Dropping A Fire-Breathing 5-Speed In Our Turbo-Charged Police Interceptor

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Caprice Wagon is back in the shop for the rest of its upgrades. Jimmy and Jeremy add a new drivetrain to give our cruiser a boost in horsepower and then we add a few custom touches before taking the whole tribe on a cross town adventure in the Carcass family truckster.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our split-bumper Camaro receives a hand-crafted exhaust, designed by one of Magnaflow's own.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew creates a custom exhaust with some TIG Tech, and they lay out a new living room for our EBC Supercharged Coyote Mustang.
programme.sub-title: Tired Supercharged Coyote Mustang Interior Gets an Overhaul

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our SPEC Mustang Project is back for final touches, as we get it ready to hit the track. After we finish our upgrades, we do just that and head to a Summit Racing Event and put it to the test.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: This 1970 Mustang will take a 50 year leap into the future, and we're building it to give away! EBC Brakes is teaming up with Detroit Muscle to turn this pony car into a stallion.
programme.sub-title: Taking A 1970 Mustang From Pony To Stallion

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: The white stallion is back! Our famous Ford 300 comes home to the Engine Power shop for even BIGGER POWER upgrades. We throw the kitchen sink at our Buzzin' Half Dozen, including stronger internals, higher flowing induction, and a custom EFI system. How much will Ford's biggest inline 6 make? We'll find out.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: There are four basic elements that affect an engine's performance: spark, fuel, air, and lubrication. We'll show you how to improve each of them WITHOUT cracking open your powerplant.
programme.sub-title: How To Achieve Power Gains Without Taking Apart Your Engine

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Turbo pioneer, Kenny Duttweiler steps in to lend a hand with our LME 427 ci LSX engine. Boosting this bullet with a high-tech turbo system produces a lot of excitement and big dyno numbers!

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We show you all the trucks, from late models to classics, including BIGFOOT, and a drifting exhibition, that are on display to the public at the first annual Power Nationals event in Nashville.

programme.desc: Final top end mods, rear locker & traction bars installed before our 1 ton dually hits the strip.

programme.desc: Mopar fans rejoice! Chrysler's venerable muscle car powerplant gets a big cubic inch increase and the induction package you've been asking for.

programme.title: Carcass

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We work on the Triple Threat Camaro... and play at the OSCR drag race in Bowling Green, KY.

programme.title: Carcass

programme.sub-title: Adding More Power to the Rally Car's 4 Cylinder

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We get the seats covered on Hard Charger, and she gets a fresh look from the rear.
programme.sub-title: Hard Charger - Interior and Out Back

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The EBC Fastback Mustang is transformed from an iconic fastback to a muscle packed stallion.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1971 Chevy Caprice, Project Fat Stack, ROARS to life after almost a year of work. Tommy and Peyton give the nitty gritty on exhaust installation and finish the interior. Fat Stack turns heads in downtown Nashville to the delight of the Broadway crowd.
programme.sub-title: Fat Stack - Part 14: Clean, Mean, and Candy Green

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We buy a '89 Chevy Silverado, with aspirations of turning it into a high performing sport truck. programme.title: Shoelaces for Christmas
programme.desc: Jennifer Miller, a self-centered teenager, learns the importance of giving during the Christmas season when her mother falls ill with cancer. While working at a homeless shelter, she meets unexpected friends who change her perspective.

programme.title: Christmas Oranges
programme.desc: Experience the journey of Rose, an orphan who teaches hope to all those around her in this poignant Christmas based on a classic holiday tale.

programme.title: We Three Kings
programme.desc: Amy, Catherine, and Charles Fay can't wait for their Uncle Henry to arrive for Christmas. This is the first year since Mama passed away and the children are working together to fill the void and put together a Christmas play at their church. With the help of Uncle Henry's new song, "We Three Kings", not only is the Christmas pageant a success, but the children learn truths about Jesus and the gifts that were given to Him by the Magi.

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.title: By God's Grace
programme.desc: In the tradition of a classic "A Christmas Carol", this film offers many lessons on the importance of giving and the cause and effect our choices have on others.

programme.title: Shoelaces for Christmas
programme.desc: Jennifer Miller, a self-centered teenager, learns the importance of giving during the Christmas season when her mother falls ill with cancer. While working at a homeless shelter, she meets unexpected friends who change her perspective.

programme.title: Christmas on Salvation Street
programme.desc: Noah Davis is a Pastor in an affluent community. Depressed after losing his wife to illness, he is contacted by an old friend who has opened a mission in a rough inner city neighborhood. With Christmas approaching, he packs up and together with his two daughters, moves into Salvation Street Mission. Now the family must struggle with the challenges they face in the crime ridden community.

programme.title: My Son, My Savior
programme.desc: A powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary. The film imagines Mary's childhood, growing up, celebrating the annual feasts and hearing the prophecies about a coming Messiah who would redeem Israel.

programme.desc: Mikey Finnegan, a 17-year-old from Philly, dreams of becoming a pro gamer. After a Christmas Eve attack leaves him in a coma, he travels back to Bethlehem. Guided by a Guardian Angel, he must find baby Jesus to return home.

programme.desc: Experience the journey of Rose, an orphan who teaches hope to all those around her in this poignant Christmas based on a classic holiday tale.

programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.title: The Miracle Of The Cards
programme.desc: There's no such thing as miracles. That's what a skeptical reporter (Kirk Cameron) thought until he met Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster). Craig is an eight-year-old boy with a brain tumor and less than a year to live. Looking for hope, his mother (Catherine Oxenberg) pushes to break the Guinness World Record for receiving the most get-well cards. They receive an incredible 1.3 million cards and shatter the old record. However Craig continues to get worse.

programme.title: Homeless For The Holidays
programme.desc: When an uncaring executive falls from the corporate ladder, he learns how difficult it can be to find work and compassion in today's economy. He eventually accepts a humiliating job, but with bills rapidly piling up, and not enough money to go around, he quickly discovers that, unless something changes soon, he'll lose everything by Christmas. Will family and faith be enough to bring joy when you're Homeless for The Holidays?

programme.title: Teletubbies Classic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies Classic
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies Classic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are feeling hungry, so they sit down to eat some Tubby Toast, but the Tubby Toaster isn't working. They watch a little girl called Becky make chocolate flake cakes for her friend Mark.

programme.title: Teletubbies Classic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies run to see Debbie and the children singing songs. A voice trumpet appears and plays a game with Po and Tinky Winky. It's called "Two Little Teletubbies Sitting On A Hill".

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

Fettuccine gets mustard; both the seed and the leafy green! Bacon and fried rice are ultimate comfort foods, but have you ever tried it with cardamom in the mix? Next up, a frosty, golden Turmeric Semifreddo, studded with jewel-like apricots and pistachios! Last but not least is a steaming bowl of mussels, spiced with not one, not two, but three kinds of ginger! How can you not 'root' for these dishes?

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer challenges the competitors to work in teams to create a twist on traditional Hanukkah jelly doughnuts; the bakers get creative with holiday decorated upside-down cakes to satisfy the judges.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Host Jesse Palmer asks the five bakers to create an over-the-top version of a holiday trifle. Then, the classics continue in the main heat when the competitors make the ultimate Charlotte royale for judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer kicks things off by asking the final four competitors to create a holiday macaron tower. In the main heat, the bakers must feature an assigned icing style -- marzipan, buttercream or mirror glaze -- in a stunning cake to win $25,000.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall look back at how the final four bakers made it to the finale, revealing the best bakes of the season and some of the slip-ups; they give an exciting behind-the-scenes view into how the show is made.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Builds
programme.desc: A giant edible skating rink with fondant figurines for a surprise party; a non-profit organization requests a unique way to get kids excited about seasonal fruits and veggies for an upcoming cooking class.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Builds
programme.desc: A company commissions a five-foot replica of their local town Main Street decked out as a winter wonderland for their Christmas party; touring Reptile Company wants their company mascot, an Asian water monitor lizard, made for their holiday party.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Builds
programme.desc: Brenda and Alisha create a larger-than-life-sized Nutcracker for a local dance academy's performance of the eponymous ballet; a non-profit organization commissions a turn-of-the-century house in Haiti for their annual fundraiser auction.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Builds
programme.desc: The Osmond family asks Brenda and Alisha to build a replica of their 150-year-old log cabin for a fundraiser to benefit the National Multiple Sclerosis Society; Alisha's relatives surprise their son with a basketball-themed Santa Claus cookie.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Builds
programme.desc: Hale Centre Theatre in Salt Lake City is launching its 34th season of "A Christmas Carol," and Brenda and Alisha are asked to create their grandest build yet; a build to thank a local firehouse.

programme.title: Holiday Cookie Builds
programme.desc: Brenda and Alisha use a drone to help them design a shortbread replica of the City County Clock Tower and its Romanesque architecture; a replica of an English cottage-style home as the centerpiece for a holiday brunch.

programme.title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
programme.desc: Bakers vie to create the definitive gingerbread showpiece; they receive a competition curveball mid-challenge that requires them to switch gears from assembling gingerbread to creating holiday treats to act as functional parts of their final pieces.

programme.title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
programme.desc: Three bakers race to create their take on a gingerbread North Pole; the judges hand out some high praise and some cold critiques while trying to decide whose gingerbread masterpiece is good enough to give its creator a trip to the grand finale.

programme.title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
programme.desc: Three finalists create their biggest Ultimate Holiday Celebration scene; the competitor that wows the judges the most will win the grand prize and be featured in Food Network Magazine as the first Holiday Gingerbread Showdown Champion.

programme.title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
programme.desc: Paige Davis unleashes the three bakers on a challenge to make gingerbread showpieces that tell quite a tail; they also create holiday treats delicious enough to prove the bite is as big as their bark.

programme.title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
programme.desc: The three bakers use their sense of humor to make their best gingerbread creations while envisioning the worst Christmas ever.

programme.title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown
programme.desc: A cookier, a caker and a gingerbread book maker use their baking skills to give the big man a much-needed day off; classic gingerbread techniques, showstopping icing artwork and tropical decorations on full display.

programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists create their most festive vision of how Santa Claus auditions his next crop of elves.

programme.desc: Jonathan Bennett challenges the three remaining teams of cake and sugar artists to show how Santa celebrates the off-season with a side job.

programme.desc: Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

programme.title: Holiday Wars

programme.title: Buddy vs. Duff Holiday

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: Last in the deeply moving series about the Holocaust. While the hunt to find surviving Nazis continues today, efforts are being made to preserve the memory of their tragic victims.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The post-war government of Germany is shown. The U.S. in Cologne puts things in order. The Potsdam Conference and Nuremberg War Crimes Trials are shown.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: With Berlin divided by the Allies, a new world emerges from the ashes. At the Nuremberg Trials, top Nazi leaders face judgment for war crimes, including Hermann Göring, Rudolf Hess, Joachim von Ribbentrop, and Albert Speer. The trials expose the full scale of Nazi atrocities and set a precedent for international justice. As the world reflects, justice seeks to bring closure to the horrors of WWII.

programme.title: 16 Photographs at Ohrdruf
programme.desc: With only a small stack of his grandfather's photos for guidance, filmmaker Matthew Nash tries to understand a family secret that began on April 4, 1945. His search reveals the horror of the first concentration camp found by the Allies and the amazing story of the soldiers who uncovered the Holocaust.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: In the Warsaw ghetto, Emanuel Ringelblum and the other members of the documentary group Oyneg Shabbos collected whatever they could to recount life in the ghetto. When they learn of the death at Chelmno of Jews from neighboring towns and from the Lodz ghetto at the end of 1941, they realized that the Nazis and their local auxiliaries had embarked on an operation of annihilation.

programme.title: World War II: Total War
programme.desc: The end of the Second World War brought destruction and liberation, relief mixed with grief. Explore the aftermath of total war. The war crimes trials that sought to prosecute unprecedented crimes and established new laws that hoped to prevent their repetition. The creation of the United Nations, the hopes for an 'enduring peace' and the fate of millions of refugees displaced by total war.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: This episode delves into the darkest chapters of the war: the Holocaust and the ideology of racial superiority that fueled Nazi atrocities. It explores the calculated genocide, forced labor camps, and the systematic destruction of entire communities across Europe. The program highlights the resistance movements that fought back, as well as the moral dilemmas faced by the Allied powers.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In January 1945, the Soviet army discovered the existence of Auschwitz and then of more than a hundred concentration camps. The Allies progressed through Europe, leaving many victims of rape and summary executions behind, and finally conquered Berlin. On April 30, Hitler committed suicide: The war was finally over. But who won it?

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: In 1938, the Third Reich annexed Austria and applied a policy of systematic expulsion of foreign Jews resident on its territory. By 1 January 1939, there were no longer any Jewish businesses on Reich soil. The situation of German Jews grew worse: banished from German society, demonized by the regime, they were presented as the enemy within, but no longer had any possibility of leaving the country.

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: 'The Concise History of World War II' begins by looking at Germany during the years between World War one and World War two, and pays particular attention to a young and charismatic politician by the name of Adolf Hitler, who dramatically rose to prominence as leader of the Nazi Party during a time of severe economic instability and mass unemployment.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: On 20 November 1945, the trial of the top brass of the Third Reich, including Göring, opened in Nuremberg, the city where the anti-Jewish laws were drawn up in 1935. One year later, the international military tribunal sentenced 12 of the accused to death, and seven to jail. Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: Upon their arrival at Auschwitz, families were separated on the unloading platforms. Those who entered the camp were shaved off and tattooed. Prisoners could see smoke rising from the huge chimneys. What's all this about? And what happened to the elderly and children after they got off the Holocaust trains?

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.
programme.sub-title: Women of Ravensbrück: Inside Nazi Horrors

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: Tokyo, 1946. Under American occupation, 28 top Japanese officials are tried for war crimes by an international tribunal, modeled on Nuremberg. The trial lasts two and a half years, with key figures like former PM Hideki Tojo held responsible for Pearl Harbor. Despite calls for the Emperor's prosecution, Hirohito remains in power. How did the trial impact Japan, and why did it take so long?

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: By summer 1942, deportations were systematic across those parts of Europe occupied by the Nazis. The convoys which arrived in Auschwitz-Birkenau came from Poland, also western and southern Europe. Hitler issued an order for all Polish Jews to be killed before December 1942. The pace of deportations picked up, and the children from the ghetto of Lodz were deported starting from early September.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: This film permanently and accurately documents the trial of the Nazi defendants at Nuremberg. It includes German footage of Nazi personalities and activities interwoven with film shot during the trials. It follows the story of the rise and fall of Nazism from the putsch in a Munich beer hall to the Nuremberg trials, and contains flashbacks of a variety of Nazi crimes against humanity.

At the same time, it tells the story of Nazism's systematic spoliation, often paid for in blood.

When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand.

Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

Starletta (Wendy Raquel Robinson), her boyfriend, Demond (Michael Jai White), and the three women he's been cheating on her with also arrive for the episode. Soon, shameless Demond starts chasing after Angel.

Intent on driving back to Chicago to win Rae back, Michael instead finds himself stuck in a hillbilly town.

Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell (Donald Sutherland) assumes that when a friend (Brooke Adams) complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec (Jeff Goldblum) and his wife (Veronica Cartwright) discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: When a Stranger Calls
programme.desc: A retired police detective (Charles Durning) hunts a deranged British seaman out to re-create a baby sitter's (Carol Kane) horror.

programme.title: Bitch Slap
programme.desc: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

programme.title: Coming Soon
programme.desc: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: As a nurse, Coffy (Pam Grier) has seen the ill effects of drugs up close, but it isn't until her little sister becomes addicted to heroin that she finally decides to wage a one-woman battle. Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.title: A Chorus Line
programme.desc: Hundreds of hopefuls congregate at a cattle call for Broadway dancers. A sour director, Zach (Michael Douglas), and his brusque assistant (Terrence Mann) whittle down the ranks until they're left with 16 dancers. All tell their life stories -- some tragic, some comic -- and explain their love of dance. Tension mounts when Cassie (Alyson Reed) -- once both a big star and the director's lover but now desperate for a part -- auditions. But Zach must choose only the best for his show.

programme.title: The Sapphires
programme.desc: One ambitious manager. Four unknown singers. The tour that put them on the charts wasn't even on a map.

programme.title: Bollywood Hero
programme.desc: After burning almost all of his professional bridges in Hollywood, actor Chris Kattan searches for Bollywood stardom in India.

programme.title: Bollywood Hero
programme.desc: After publicly breaking one of India's greatest social taboos, Chris Kattan tries to salvage his reputation while securing financing for the film.

programme.title: Bollywood Hero
programme.desc: With financing for the film in place, Kattan discovers that he is not the leading man in the project.

programme.title: Wish Upon a Star
programme.desc: After a brainy tomboy's (Danielle Harris) wish to trade places with her pretty, popular sister (Katherine Heigl), it comes true.

programme.title: Boat Trip
programme.desc: After Nick (Horatio Sanz) makes an insensitive remark, his travel agent decides to get some payback by sending him and his best friend, Jerry (Cuba Gooding Jr.), on a cruise for gay men. As the true nature of their situation gradually dawns on them, they start to get over their feelings of homophobia and meet potential mates. For Nick, love takes the form of a gorgeous model, Inga (Victoria Silvstedt), while Jerry develops feelings for dance instructor Gabriella (Roselyn Sánchez).

programme.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again
programme.desc: For years, Jon Porter (Michael Gross) has been repressing memories of how his older sister was murdered -- and how he electrocuted her three assailants to death. Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell (Donald Sutherland) assumes that when a friend (Brooke Adams) complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec (Jeff Goldblum) and his wife (Veronica Cartwright) discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Duchess
programme.desc: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

programme.title: Tammie Brown's Holiday Sparkle
programme.desc: Tammie Brown's roller coaster of catchy tunes, impish behavior and inevitable disaster; guests include Kelly Mantle, Sherry Vine and Ongina.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: Chick Fight
programme.desc: When Anna joins an all-female, underground fight club to turn her mess of a life around, she soon discovers she's much more personally connected to the history of the club than she ever could have imagined.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly (Bette Midler) was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash (Danny DeVito) immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Boat Trip
programme.desc: After Nick (Horatio Sanz) makes an insensitive remark, his travel agent decides to get some payback by sending him and his best friend, Jerry (Cuba Gooding Jr.), on a cruise for gay men. As the true nature of their situation gradually dawns on them, they start to get over their feelings of homophobia and meet potential mates. For Nick, love takes the form of a gorgeous model, Inga (Victoria Silvstedt), while Jerry develops feelings for dance instructor Gabriella (Roselyn Sánchez).

programme.title: But I'm a Cheerleader
programme.desc: Megan (Natasha Lyonne) considers herself a typical American girl. She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham.

programme.title: The Ten
programme.desc: A series of interweaving vignettes spoof the Ten Commandments. In one story, a skydiver (Adam Brody) forgets to pack his parachute. When he lands, he doesn't die, but gets stuck in the ground, causing a media circus and jeopardizing his relationship with his girlfriend, Kelly (Winona Ryder). Later, Kelly begins a tumultuous relationship with a ventriloquist's dummy. In another story, a doctor (Ken Marino) obsessed with pranks accidentally kills a patient and winds up in jail.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity puts a man named Slevin (Josh Hartnett) in the middle of a war between two rival New York crime lords: The Rabbi (Ben Kingsley) and the Boss (Morgan Freeman). While under the watchful eyes of Detective Brikowski (Stanley Tucci) and well-known assassin Goodkat (Bruce Willis), Slevin must quickly devise a plan to save his skin before his luck runs out.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze (Christian Bale) works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze (Casey Affleck), Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord (Woody Harrelson). Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home.

programme.title: Only God Forgives
programme.desc: In Thailand, a drug trafficker's (Ryan Gosling) icy mother (Kristin Scott Thomas) sends him on a mission to avenge his older brother, who was killed for beating an underage prostitute to death.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Queens
programme.desc: Ailing mafia capo Joseph Scoleri (Paul Sorvino) is released after spending 20 years in prison, and tries to reconnect with his daughter as he realizes the life he knew no longer exists.

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: Jonathan Fisher (Christopher Reeve) is a reporter struggling to keep his job at a magazine. Assigned to write a real-life prostitution exposé, he fails to gain information from his subjects and decides to make up his own story about a pimp. The piece revives his career, but his fictional character turns out to be strangely similar to Fast Black (Morgan Freeman), an actual pimp, who is outraged and demands that Jonathan spill his sources. When the police get involved, matters get even uglier.

programme.title: Pop Profiles

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: During the last two years of her life, Princess Diana (Naomi Watts) campaigns against the use of land mines and has a secret love affair with a Pakistani heart surgeon (Naveen Andrews).

programme.title: Cher: Life in the Spotlight
programme.desc: Tracing Cher's life from her childhood stage fright to her rise as an iconic star in music, TV and movies.

programme.title: 27: Gone Too Soon
programme.desc: Unseen footage and interviews with medical experts, music critics and people who knew the famous artists who all coincidentally died at the age of 27.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Infamous Crime Scenes: OJ
programme.desc: Turn back the clock and uncover the truth behind the OJ Simpson trial.

programme.title: Infamous Crime Scenes
programme.desc: John Lennon's murder site; Graceland; O.J. Simpson; serial killer Richard Speck; Ronald Reagan's attempted assassination.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
